# Studio System

> Padova-based software studio: AI-native development — customer apps and websites, dependable legacy and ERP modernization, and operational AI agents that run inside your stack (ERP, email, documents), not only in a chat window.

## What we do

- Ship modern web and client-facing applications with shorter, measurable delivery cycles.
- Renew and integrate legacy systems (billing, inventory, admin) without always replacing the ERP.
- Deploy AI agents that complete real operational work with logging, approvals, and human escalation when judgment is needed.

## Who we work with

Small and mid-sized businesses (especially in Italy): quotes, orders, invoices, payment reminders, month-end routines, and the “desk work” patterns that repeat with different names and numbers each time.

- English homepage: /en

Set the public site URL to your production domain (e.g. via NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL on Vercel) so Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap, and robots use consistent absolute links.
